name: Permanent-magnet DC motor
summary: A permanent-magnet DC motor uses a permanent magnetic field rather than a separately connected field winding.
description: A permanent-magnet DC motor uses a permanent magnetic field rather than a separately connected field winding. Its armature and control connections still require product documentation.
